name: record-replay
description:
Record & Replay 录制回放。

Aliases: @record-replay, @rr, record, replay, 录制, 回放.

Use Record & Replay when the user asks to record a workflow, capture a process, or replay a recorded workflow. This plugin launches an external Chrome browser, records user actions via CDP, and automatically generates a Playwright Python replay script that can be run from the right-side Replay panel.

interface.shortDescription: Record once, replay as a Playwright script
interface.longDescription: Record & Replay launches an external Chrome/Edge browser, lets you demonstrate a workflow while recording your actions via Chrome DevTools Protocol, then automatically generates a Playwright Python replay script. The script is listed in the right-side Replay panel where you can run it with one click; failures are routed to the main pipeline for automatic repair.
defaultPrompt: Record my workflow and generate a replay script
